newsitem.title: USA: Essex says working capital decreases.
newsitem.headline: Essex says working capital decreases.

text.p: Essex Corp said Tuesday that its working capital decreased from $100,000 on December 29, 1996, to a deficit of $293,000 on March 30, 1997.
The company said its working capital position continues to deteriorate since March 30, 1997, because of operating losses.
The company's accounts receivable financing arrangement with its bank expires on May 31, 1997.
At March 30, 1997, the amount advanced was $758,469, Essex said.
The company said it is negotiating with the bank to extend the agreement.
There is no assurance that the financing arrangement will be extended or replaced, Essex said.
The company said it is attempting to alleviate its working capital deficiency but there is no assurance that its attempts will be successful.
